caption: A photorealistic film still from a contemporary Chinese university romance short drama, cinematic live-action realism, square 1:1 image with 1024x1024 framing. Rich but natural skin texture, believable hands, fabrics and practical light, emotionally restrained acting, carefully staged subjects, no text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Gu Xi is a 20-year-old Chinese female art student with long straight black hair, naturally expressive eyes, cream cardigan over white shirt and light blue jeans. Jiang Jin is a 22-year-old Chinese male computer science student with short neat black hair, charcoal jacket over white T-shirt, reserved face and a subtle old scar near his left wrist. Zhou Qian is a Chinese female student aged 21 with long wavy dark hair and powder blue outfit. H University digital art festival takes place in a real modern campus exhibition laboratory with a giant blue-violet LED display and realistic equipment. Suspenseful closing frame in the digital arts hall after midnight. Gu Xi stands near the left foreground turned away from Jiang Jin, secretly typing a message on a smartphone held in both hands; her expression is calculated but calm. Across the room, Jiang Jin in his charcoal jacket glances down at the faint light of a phone inside his coat pocket, not yet noticing her observation. Single square composition with two clearly separated characters and blue-violet LED installation in the distance, shallow atmospheric depth, no legible phone text.
